title: Piece: Little Waltz in G
summary: A waltz that uses the last three chapters.

steps.title: Before you play
text: This waltz uses everything from the last three chapters: the key of G, eighth notes, and a dotted quarter note in bar 4.
Find the two F sharps before you start.

steps.title: Slowly first
text: Take it slowly. Count **1 2 3**, and **1 and 2 and 3 and** where the eighths are.
